description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions on OpenAI gpt-oss-20b open-weight reasoning model with tool calling. Set your OpenAI SDK base URL to https://agents.citiviewgroup.com/v1/gpt-oss-20b and pay per token with x402 instead of an API key: $0.6 per million input and $0.9 per million output tokens, minimum $0.002 a call, at most $0.0099. The 402 quotes your request's maximum; "upto" payers are charged only the tokens used. Same request/response shape as OpenAI (tool calling, reasoning, streaming supported), up to 4096 output tokens. Costs $0.0099 USDC per call (x402).
